hint_ladder: Announce the problem or the main point before you explain it.
Use the thing is with a comma or with that, followed by a full clause.
Start with the words: The ___ is, we don't have enough time.
teaching_content.reveal_form: The thing is, we don't have enough time.
canonical_forms: The thing is, we don't have enough time.
alternative_realizations: The thing is that nobody told him.
